headline: Stlican Shelf and Western Isles Flare as Inland Shifts Abate
war_summary: Fresh upheaval has swept the coastal sectors and eastern marches over the past three hours. While base exchanges in Linn of Mercy and Stonecradle have momentarily halted despite lingering attrition, fighting has flared violently across the island belts and along Stlican Shelf. Stlican Shelf witnessed eight strategic base changes in the last two hours alone, accompanied by over two thousand casualties as Warden counteroffensives rattled The Pale House and Vulpine Watch. Contrary to its earlier stillness, Fisherman's Row was suddenly reactivated with six base turnovers across Eidolo and Black Well, leaving the hex split and one strongpoint wrecked. Out east, Godcrofts saw four separate bases transition into Colonial hands, locking down the archipelago. Along the northern front, Mooring County remains a volatile cauldron, recording three more base flips as Warden forces batter the lone Colonial foothold under accelerating casualty rates. Meanwhile, Weathered Expanse continues to absorb staggering losses of nearly thirty-eight hundred dead in two hours, yet the battle lines hold firm against the carnage.
